Title: JupyterLab PluginManager lock-rule enforcement bypass
Description: JupyterLab's plugin manager exposes administrator controls intended to prevent users from enabling or disabling selected plugins. Two server-side enforcement gaps let an authenticated user bypass those controls with direct requests to `/lab/api/plugins`.
AffectedVersions: All versions starting from 4.1.0 before 4.5.10, all versions starting from 4.6.0 before 4.6.2
NotImpacted: All versions before 4.1.0, all versions starting from 4.5.10 before 4.6.0, all versions starting from 4.6.2
